How to enter

Registration for the MGT Annual Competition is completely free. Here is how it works.

1

Fill in the registration form

Complete the registration form on this website.

2

Record your 90-second video

Once the annual registration period opens, record a 90-second video showcasing your talent.

3

Upload it and tag us

Upload it to Facebook or Instagram, tag us @mygospeltalent and mention us in the comment section so we can easily find your entry. Make sure you are following our official page.

4

Wait for your confirmation

Selected applicants will receive confirmation from MGT in the comment section, with further details sent to their registered email address, including their scheduled date for the physical audition.

Register, showcase your talent, and take your shot at the MGT Live Stage!

More than a competition

MY GOSPEL TALENT (MGT) exists to help people discover, develop, and deploy their God-given talents for God's glory. The annual MGT event is one part of a larger platform built for discovering talent, developing people, building careers, creating opportunities, and preserving gospel talent for the next generation.

The Annual MGT Event

The annual MGT event is MGT's flagship stage, a live competition open to singers, rappers, poets, and spoken word artists. It's the most visible part of MGT, but it's built on the same mission that drives everything else: discover, develop, deploy.
